user_decision.meaning: Continue preparation without repeatedly requiring unknown origin facts; no claim of independent generalization.

cases.title: Quellbindung
cases.expected: Absolute source path and full SHA256 match pinned manifest; any mismatch stops the affected comparison.

cases.title: Video-Decodierung
cases.expected: Full selected video stream decodes; decoded frame counts300 each exceptV02=720; zero decode errors. Compare to current pinned source, not a generic fps assumption.

cases.title: Zeitbasis
cases.expected: Every decoded frame has monotonically increasing PTS. V02 video range[0,30s), audio/container30.016s separately; never extend video range from container.

cases.title: Audioformate
cases.expected: Source range[60,180s) decodes to960000 finite mono8kHz probe samples. Source44.1kHzPCM16/48kHzfloatPCM/44.1kHzAAC remain separately identified. This probe proves neither loudness nor beat correctness.

cases.title: Dubletten
cases.expected: V02 and gemini_generated_video_741eaffa.mp4 share one exact byte identity; no duplicate sample weight or split leakage. Other7duplicate pairs remain grouped in full inventory.

cases.title: Referenzframes
cases.expected: Source SHA, stream, exact frame index and retained image SHA agree; V02 frame360 at15s, others frame150 at5s. AI draft is never silently promoted to human reference.

cases.title: Unbekannte Farbe
cases.expected: Missing color primaries/transfer/matrix/range remain unknown; do not claim color/SDR qualification or silently invent metadata. Future validator behavior requires its own implementation test.

cases.title: Bildinhalt
cases.expected: Human reviewer marks exact-frame facts correct/incorrect/uncertain before scoring later PB output; report omissions and hallucinations separately. Unreviewed draft cannot produce PASS.

cases.title: Musikalische Referenz
cases.expected: Annotate source60..90s initially; beat/downbeat/section/blend/dominance distinct, uncertainty explicit. No old app predictions used as answer key. Extend only to actual annotated events.

cases.title: Nativeanalyse-Vergleich
cases.expected: Pinned input/profile/model/config; compare candidate with newly measured native output and independently reviewed references. Changes in counts alone do not establish improvement.

cases.title: Messmodi und Ressourcen
cases.expected: fresh-cold/fresh-warm/result-cache-reuse separate; stage times, sensor coverage, foreign load, RAM/disk, bookkeeping vs sampledGPUmaximum separate. Unknown sensor not zero.

cases.title: Evaluationsisolation
cases.expected: Ratings only run-owned evaluation files; no product brain feedback/training. Frozen brain/projector identity required for future Director comparisons. This document is not executed product-isolation proof.
